messages:
nora-s: Quick help please 3 payroll. During Q3 I split time working from WA (home), CA (office), and NY (temporary family visit). My Sept paycheck shows CA state withholding for the whole period. I believe NY should have some withholding for the weeks I was there. Can payroll advise how this will be reported on my W-2 and if any refunds/credits are possible?

jen-people-ops: Thanks for flagging @nora-s. Can you list the exact dates you were physically in each state and confirm your home address on file? We'll loop payroll.

nora-s: WA (home): 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-20 to present. NY visit: 2026-09-05 to 2026-09-18. CA office: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-04. Home address in Workday is WA.

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2026-999: "Multi-state telework withholding (WA/CA/NY) - Nora S (emp 52678)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Thanks. Quick notes: WA has no state income tax (so no withholding there). CA withholding applies for CA-sourced wages and resident employees; NY has withholding if you performed services there. We'll need to: 1) pull payroll ledger by workdate, 2) allocate wages to each state by workdate, 3) compute withheld amounts and identify over/under withholding, 4) decide if a W-2 with multiple state entries suffices or if a W-2c is needed (if withheld amounts reported were wrong).

liz-mgr: I can confirm Nora's planned NY visit was approved as temporary remote work. Manager attestation added to ticket.

nora-s: Thanks. My CPA asked whether SUTA (state unemployment) or local NYC taxes could be affected. I know WA has different unemployment rules.

samir-payroll: Good question. State unemployment (SUTA) is employer-side and typically based on employer registration and the employee's work situs; we will not reclassify employer SUTA retroactively unless there was an administrative error. Local NYC taxes (if any) might apply if you were physically working within NYC; we need the city-level addresses/days. For W-2: most likely we'll show CA wages and NY wages separately in boxes 15-17 if allocation changes. Example illustration (not final):

Box 15: CA    2026   8200.00
Box 15: NY    2026   5600.00
Box 16: CA wages   8200.00
Box 16: NY wages   5600.00
Box 17: CA tax     450.00
Box 17: NY tax     220.00

samir-payroll: If CA withholding was taken on NY wages, payroll can either: a) adjust future withholding to offset over/under, b) issue refunds if within payroll refund policy, or c) provide documentation for you to claim credits on NY/CA filings. We'll determine best path after ledger review.

jen-people-ops: Action items: Nora - confirm the specific NYC vs rest-of-NY address for the visit; samir - pull ledger and post allocation and proposed correction method in PR-2026-999; liz - confirm manager attestation (done). I'll check back EOW.

nora-s: Confirmed - I was in Manhattan (Chelsea) 9/5-9/18. CPA cc'd on ticket. Thanks all.

samir-payroll: Pulling ledger now. Expect initial allocation and recommended correction approach in 5 business days. If we need to issue a W-2c we'll note expected timing.
